title: Clichê
comment:
32-bar AABA bossa in D minor / F major at 130 BPM. Loops end to start.

- **A:** Dm line cliché (D-C#-C-B inner voice) into Gm9-C13-Fmaj9, tritone-sub turnaround Em7b5-Eb7 back to Dm
- **B:** Bbmaj9 with backdoor ii-Vs (Ebm9-Ab13, Bbm9-Eb13) and tritone sub Ab7 for D7

Rootless A/B guitar voicings, flute melody, tenor sax countermelody from A2, brush kit with bossa clave.
